# SEA HAG AUNTIE

SEA HAG AUNTIE CR 7
A lurking shape leers from the brine, lidless eyes glaring
from a tangle cloud of sodden hair. Her long claws twitch
with the shifting current.
AC 15 (Natural Armor) Initiative +5 (15)
HP 151 (18d8 + 72) Size Medium
Speed 30 ft., Swim 40 ft. Type Fey
MOD SAVE MOD SAVE MOD SAVE
Str 19 +4 +4 Dex 15 +2 +2 Con 18 +4 +7
Int 15 +2 +2 Wis 13 +1 +4 Cha 18 +4 +7
Skills Deception +7, Insight +4, Perception +4, Stealth +8
Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 14
Languages Aquan, Common, Giant
Drives Keep Grudges, Punish Disrespect, Sow Mistrust
XP 2,900 Proficiency Bonus +3
Traits
Illusory Mimicry. The hag can perfectly mimic the voice
and appearance of any Beast or Humanoid that is Cursed
by or Indebted to it.
Coven Craft. While at least two allies with this trait are
within 30 feet of the hag, its Attack Rolls have Advantage
and creatures have Disadvantage on any saving throw
they make against effects it controls.
Actions
Multiattack. The hag makes two attacks, one of which it
can replace with a use of its Pilfered Spell, Seed Terror, or
Steal Passion.
Rotflesh Claw. Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13
(2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic
damage.
Pilfered Spell. The sea hag casts a spell of Level 3 or below
known by a creature Cursed by or Indebted to it, using
that creature’s spell slots.
Seed Terror. Illusory blight spreads from the hag in a 15-
foot Emanation, making flesh appear to sag and rot. Each
creature in the area must make a
Intelligence or Wisdom Saving Throw:
(Target’s Choice) DC 15. Failure: The creature is
Frightened for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
Steal Passion (Concentration). The hag tears a token from a
creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make a Charisma
Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature is Cursed.
Failure by 5 or More: The hag can maintain this effect
without Concentration.
While Cursed in this way, the creature suffers one of the
following effects of the hag’s choice.
The creature can’t speak louder than a whisper, and can’t
cast spells of Level 1 or above.
The creature’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet and it can’t take
Bonus Actions or Reactions.
The creature has Disadvantage on any d20 Test that uses
Strength or Charisma.
Bilebrine (Recharge 5-6, Level 5 Spell). Stinging brine
surges over a creature the hag can see within 60 feet,
forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15.
Failure: 22 (5d8) Acid damage plus 22 (5d8) Necrotic
damage. Success: Half damage.
A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is
infected with Merthirst.
Bonus Actions
Drowner’s Dive. The hag moves up to half its Swim Speed,
then can attempt to Hide if it has at least Half Cover.
Sargassum Grasp. A tangle of seaweed blooms to envelop
a submerged creature within 30 feet, forcing it to make a
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature
is Restrained until the end of its next turn (escape DC 15)
and dragged 15 feet in a direction of the hag’s choice.
Death Glare (Only if Bloodied). One Frightened creature
within 30 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC
15. Failure: The creature is Stunned until the end of its
next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The creature drops to 0
Hit Points.
Reactions
Courage to Dread. Trigger: A creature within 30 feet
succeeds on an Intelligence or Wisdom Saving Throw.
Response: The hag deals 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage to it.

## Referenced definitions from the same PDF

Hag Debts
A creature that has made an unfulfilled promise to a hag, or
one that removes a Curse created by a hag, becomes
Indebted to the hag.
A creature Indebted to a hag becomes psychically
connected to it. The hag can telepathically communicate
with it over any distance and can choose to perceive through
its senses at will. Once per day, the hag can force an
indebted creature to reroll d20 Test, taking the second result.

Merthirst
A creature infected with merthirst loses all appetite, its eyes
become bloodshot, and a crust of pale salt gradually
accumulates around its nose and lips. It can keep solid food
down only if washed down with sea water.

A cyclopean titan of impossible bone and living rags,
slithering with unsettling lightness through the oppressive
dark of its vaults.

AC 22 (Natural Armor)             Initiative +4 (14)

HP 507 (29d20 + 203)              Size Colossal (45 ft. tall)

Speed 50 ft., Fly 25 ft. (hover) Type Fiend (Yugoloth)

           MOD SAVE               MOD SAVE            MOD SAVE

Str 23 +6 +6 Dex 18 +4 +4 Con 25 +7 +14

Int 24 +7 +14 Wis 17 +3 +10 Cha 14 +2 +9

Vulnerabilities Bludgeoning, Cold

Resistances Necrotic; Attacks made without Advantage

Immunities Acid, Fire, Poison; Charmed, Diseased, Frightened,

Paralyzed, Poisoned

Senses Truesight 120 ft., Passive Perception 13

Languages All, Telepathy 120 ft.

Drives Balance Accounts, Inspect Deposits, Preserve the Trove

XP 62,000                                   Proficiency Bonus +7

Traits

Conniving Resistance. Charon has Advantage on Saving
Throws against spells and other magical effects.

When Charon succeeds on a saving throw against a spell,
it can choose to fail. If it does, it can end the spell's effect
at any time, with no action required.

Lord of Reckoning. Charon knows the details of every debt
owed to or by a yugoloth.

While Charon lives, merrenoloths on any plane can
teleport any portable wealth held by them to the Soul
Trove, or recall items deposited in this way to their hand,
with no action required.

Clear Ledger. At the start of each of Charon's turns, it can
end each spell affecting it.

If it does, it can't take Legendary Actions until the start of
its next turn.

Actions

Multiattack. Charon makes two attacks, one of which it
can replace with a use of its Searing Appraisal, Blood
Covenant, or Treasure Wind.

Inexorable Grasp. Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 20 ft. Hit:
24 (4d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage and the target is
Grappled (escape DC 21).

A creature Grappled in this way takes 20 Force damage at
the start of each of its turns.

Searing Appraisal. Charon gazes deeply into a creature
within 30 feet, forcing the target to make a Intelligence
Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: 21 (6d6) Fire damage plus 21
(6d6) Psychic damage and Charon's attacks have
Advantage against the target for 1 minute. Success: Half
damage.

Blood Covenant (Level 8 Spell). Charon touches a creature
 within 25 feet, Cursing it.

 Whenever the Cursed creature deals damage to Charon,
 Charon can deal twice as much Psychic damage to it. If it
 does, the creature can make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC
 22. Success: The curse ends.

 Treasure Wind (Level 8 Spell). A torrential river of spectral
 riches rushes down a 60-foot long, 15-foot wide Line
 within 300 feet of Charon, forcing each creature in the
 area to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: 45
 (10d8) Force damage. Failure by 5 or More: Each coin and
 each magic item the target is carrying but not wielding or
 attuned to is carried to a point of Charon's choice in the
 Line's area. Success: Half damage.

 Scales of Oblivion (Recharge 5-6, Level 9 Spell,
 Concentration). Bonds of spectral gold hoist a creature
 Charon can see within 60 feet off its feet, Restraining it
 (escape DC 22).

 At the end of the Restrained creature's next turn, it must
 make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: The
 creature dies and disintegrates. Success: The effect ends.

 When a creature makes this saving throw, after seeing its
 result its allies within 60 feet of it can choose one or more
 of the following effects; for each effect chosen in this way,
 the creature adds +1 to its saving throw.

    The ally takes 44 (8d10) Force damage.
    The ally sacrifices a spell slot of Level 3 or above.
    The ally takes 1 point of Exhaustion.
    One non-artifact magic item the ally is attuned to of the
    ally's choice permanently loses its magic and becomes inert.

 Legendary Actions

 Charon can take three legendary actions, choosing from
 the options below.

 Nothing for Nothing. Until the start of Charon's next turn,
 any creature that targets it with a spell or deals damage to
 it for the first time on a turn must sacrifice one Spell Slot
 of any level, or take 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage if it can't.

 Dispossess (Level 4 Spell). One creature Charon can see
 within 60 feet must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 22.
 Failure: The target becomes unattuned to one magic item
 of its choice that it is attuned to. Failure by 5 or More: The
 target becomes unattuned to each magic item it is
 attuned to.

 Each item unattuned in this way teleports into Charon's
 space.

 Let Death In (Costs 2 Actions). Charon and each other
 creature in the Soul Trove must each make a Constitution
 Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

The fiend's oversized, horned head is split by an obscene
mouth, comprising nothing but teeth and tongue; distant,
yellow-glazed eyes drip a fluid far more vile than tears.

AC 17 (Natural Armor)             Initiative +8 (18)
HP 256 (27d10 + 108)              Size Large (8 ft. tall)
Speed 40 ft.                      Type Fiend

           MOD SAVE               MOD SAVE                 MOD SAVE

Str 19 +4 +4 Dex 14 +2 +2 Con 18 +4 +10

Int 22 +6 +6 Wis 16 +3 +9 Cha 21 +5 +5

Skills Arcana +12, Insight +9, Perception +9

Resistances Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic

Surprised

Drives Guide Seekers to Evil, Spread Suffering to All

Traits

Secret-Thief. The baernaloth can read the surface thoughts
of each creature within 120 feet of it.

Creatures that aren't warded against telepathic intrusion
have Disadvantage on attacks that target the baernaloth,
and the baernaloth has Advantage on Saving Throws
against abilities they control.

Despoiling Resistance. At the end of each of the
baernaloth's turns, it can end each spell affecting it.

A spell's caster can gain one point of Exhaustion to
prevent its spell from ending this way.

Actions

Multiattack. The baernaloth makes two attacks, one of
which it can replace with a use of its Gray Fate or Erase
Deeds.

Deranging Touch. Melee Spell Attack: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit:
34 (8d6 + 6) Psychic damage.

A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage must
make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The creature
shape-shifts into a Lemure Aspirant that is hostile to all
creatures until it dies or the effect is dispelled.

Grey Fate (Level 7 Spell). The baernaloth touches a
creature, forcing it to make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC
20. Failure: 73 (6d10 + 40) Necrotic damage and the
creature is Cursed. The Cursed creature can't be returned
to life by any means short of a Wish spell. If this curse is
removed, the creature dies. Success: Half damage.

Erase Deeds (Level 7 Spell). The baernaloth twists time,
 attempting to undo the actions of a creature it can see
 within 60 feet.

 The target must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 20.
 Failure: The baernaloth can choose up to two of the
 following effects. It can choose the same option twice.

    Each creature the target killed on its previous turn is
    restored to life with 1 Hit Point.
    Each creature the target dealt damage to on its previous turn
    regains 25 Hit Points.
    Each creature the target restored Hit Points to on its
    previous turn loses 25 Hit Points.
    Each effect the target is Concentrating on ends.

 Discordant Miasma (Recharge 5-6). The baernaloth spews
 forth billowing grey vapors that coalesce in a 20-foot
 radius Sphere within 120 feet, forcing each creature in the
 area to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 35
 (10d6) Psychic damage, the creature is Charmed by the
 baernaloth, and it is hostile to all other creatures until the
 end of its next turn. Success: Half damage.

 Nail to the Sky (1/Day, Level 9 Spell, Concentration). The
 baernaloth forces a creature it can see within 120 feet to
 make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The effect
 that gravity has on the creature is reversed and it
 immediately falls 500 feet upward.

 After one minute, this effect lasts until dispelled and the
 baernaloth no longer needs Concentration to maintain it.

 Bonus Actions

 Premonition of Pain (Level 3 Spell). The baernaloth whispers
 a dark prediction, Cursing one creature within 30 feet.

 Whenever the Cursed creature succeeds on an Attack Roll
 or Saving Throw, it can choose to fail and end this effect.
 If it does not, it takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.

 Soul Tether (Level 3 Spell). One creature the baernaloth can
 see within 60 feet must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC
 20. Failure: The baernaloth teleports the creature to an
 unoccupied space within 5 feet of the baernaloth.

 Lost Passage (1/Day, Level 8 Spell). The baernaloth dies. At
 the start of each of its turns, roll a d20. On a roll of 10+,
 the baernaloth disintegrates, then forms a new body with
 half its Hit Points in an unoccupied space within 400 feet.

Bulbous, ovoid eyes glimmer with shifting lights within a
featureless grey face, devoid of mouth or nose.

HP 221 (26d8 + 104)          Size Medium (5 ft. tall)

Drives Conscript Agents, Incite Conflict, Stay Hidden

XP 10,000                              Proficiency Bonus +5

Conniving Resistance. The ultroloth has Advantage on
Saving Throws against spells and other magical effects.

When the ultroloth succeeds on a saving throw against a
spell, it can choose to fail. If it does, it can end the spell's
effect at any time, with no action required.

Venal Purge. At the start of each of the ultroloth's turns, it
can end one spell affecting it.

The spell's caster can expend an extra Spell Slot of the
spell's level to prevent this effect. If it does, the ultroloth
gains Temporary Hit Points equal to 5 times the spell's
level.

Actions

Multiattack. The ultroloth makes three attacks, one of
which it can replace with a use of its Sever Mind, if
available.

Veil-Lash. Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 25 (6d6 +
4) Force damage and the ultroloth teleports itself or the
target to an unoccupied space that can support it within
30 feet.

Sever Mind. One creature Charmed by the ultroloth must
 make an Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 35
 (10d6) nonlethal Psychic damage. Success: Half damage.

 A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is
 Dominated by the ultroloth for 24 hours and retains no
 memory of the ultroloth or of that time afterwards. This
 effect ends if the ultroloth is killed.

 the earth in a 60-foot high, 15-foot radius Column within
 100 feet, forcing each creature in the area to make a
 Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 38 (7d10) Fire
 damage and the creature is knocked Prone. Success: Half
 damage.

 Grey Fate (Recharge 5-6, Level 7 Spell). The ultroloth
 touches a creature, forcing it to make a Charisma Saving
 Throw: DC 17. Failure: 73 (6d10 + 40) Necrotic damage
 and the creature is Cursed. The creature can't be returned
 to life by any means short of a Wish spell. If this curse is
 removed, the creature dies. Success: Half damage.

 Bonus Actions

 Hypnotic Gaze (Concentration). The ultroloth intensifies its
 gaze, forcing each creature in a 30-foot Cone to make a
 Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The creature is
 Charmed and Dazed (Save Ends at end of turn).

 While it is Concentrating on this effect, attacks against the
 ultroloth have Advantage.

 Mimetic Slip (Level 5 Spell). The ultroloth teleports to an
 unoccupied space within 30 feet, then can choose one of
 the following:

    The ultroloth ends one spell of Level 5 or below affecting it.
    The utlroloth creates a perfect illusory duplicate of itself
    within 30 feet, which lasts until the end of its next turn.
    The ultroloth gains the Invisible condition until it takes
    another action.
    The ultroloth magically disguises itself as any Small or
    Medium bipedal creature until it takes any damage.
